content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the TMC Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 30-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of TMC to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for TMC recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the TMC recruitment 2026 is 30 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this notification?
faq.answer: There are a total of 12 vacancies available for various Medical and Scientific positions at Tata Memorial Centre.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for General candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for General and other unreserved category candidates is Rs. 300/-.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any fee for SC/ST candidates?
faq.answer: No, SC, ST, Female, PWD, and Ex-servicemen candidates are exempted from paying the application fee.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a Written Examination or Skill Test followed by a personal Interview for the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q6. Can I apply offline for these positions?
faq.answer: No, the application mode for the TMC recruitment 2026 is strictly online through the official website.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for Medical Officer 'F' posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for Medical Officer 'F' posts is 50 years, with applicable relaxations for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q8. What is the minimum qualification required?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification varies by post, ranging from Graduate degrees to specialized medical degrees like D.M., M.D., or M.Ch.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the selected candidates be posted?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will be posted in Punjab, specifically in New Chandigarh or Sangrur locations.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed and downloaded via the direct link provided in the Important Links section of this article.
